title: Measured-Data Scouting Decision Or Pause

decision.recommended_next_phase: Phase 3G - Research Memory / Executive Research Assistant measured-data intake queue

evidence_basis.consequence: no measured-data candidate cleared the gate
selected only a non-promoting code-regression lane
machinery regression coverage only, not measured validation

resume_conditions: User supplies a new source-data package, lead list, or paper/dataset outside the Phase 3F.1 through Phase 3F.1D search envelope.
A future search is narrower than the exhausted envelope and targets known teaching or benchmark coating packages with source-backed constants plus measured spectra.
A current-source refresh reveals newly public machine-readable measured R/T, ellipsometry, or source-code packages.
stop_rules: Do not run measured residuals without a frozen source-backed model contract.
Do not use residual shape, fitted thickness, fitted constants, or guessed substrate/backside assumptions to rescue a candidate.
Do not promote Phase 3F.1E beyond non_promoting_code_regression_fixture.
Do not open Phase 4 until a future candidate clears every required gate.
